name: NYC Building Energy & Water Data Disclosure (LL84) 2023-present
publisher: NYC Dept of Buildings / Mayor's Office of Climate & Environmental Justice (NYC Open Data 5zyy-y8am)
authority: A - statutory benchmarking filed via EPA Portfolio Manager
geographic_relevance: High - 111 8th Ave itself and 895 benchmarked properties within 1 km (Fulton 234 m, Chelsea Market 274 m, Elliott-Chelsea 852 m)
completeness: Energy fields 0% missing for anchors; 34% of properties carry an 'estimated' flag; 3-yr mean/min/max reported
limitations: Annual only (no hourly); fuel input, not useful heat; tenant-meter inclusion at 111 8th not confirmed; multi-BBL properties take the nearest lot distance; parent/child records de-duplicated

name: MapPLUTO / PLUTO 26v2
publisher: NYC Dept of City Planning (NYC Open Data 64uk-42ks)
geographic_relevance: High - 4023 lots in bounding box; 1 km circle kept
indicators_supplied: T7; joins S01 to distance and census tract
limitations: Floor areas are assessor estimates; coordinates are lot centroids

name: NYCHA Development Data Book
publisher: New York City Housing Authority (NYC Open Data evjd-dqpz)
geographic_relevance: High - Fulton, Elliott, Chelsea, Chelsea Addition
limitations: No energy data. LL84 'ELLIOTT/CHELSEA ADDITION CAMPUS' (703 units) = NYCHA Elliott 608 + Chelsea Addition 96; NYCHA Chelsea (425 apts) not matched to an LL84 record yet

name: NYS Final Disadvantaged Communities (2023)
publisher: NYS Climate Justice Working Group / NYSERDA (data.ny.gov 2e6c-s6fp)
geographic_relevance: High - 18 census tracts touching the 1 km circle; site + Fulton tract 36061008300 is a designated DAC
temporal_coverage: 2023 designation (indicators from ACS 2015-2019 and other sources)
limitations: Mixes raw values and percentiles; some indicators (home energy affordability, days above 90 F) are county-level; tract vintage may differ from PLUTO 2020 tracts (IDs matched here; verify)

name: NYC Community Air Survey + boiler emissions (Air Quality and Health Impacts)
publisher: NYC Dept of Health and Mental Hygiene (NYC Open Data c3uy-2p5r)
geographic_relevance: High - UHF42 Chelsea-Clinton, UHF34 Chelsea-Village, CD4, Manhattan, NYC
value_type: measured (land-use regression of monitors) and inventory
limitations: Neighbourhood resolution (not block-level); boiler inventory year 2019

name: NYC Heat Vulnerability Index Rankings
limitations: ZIP-level index masks the NYCHA block (10011 = 1); low discriminating power

name: TMYx 2011-2025 Central Park (WMO 725053) + ASHRAE 2025 design conditions
publisher: climate.onebuilding.org (Crawley & Lawrie) from NOAA NCEI ISD with ERA5 gap-fill; design conditions from ASHRAE Handbook - Fundamentals 2025 Ch.14
authority: B+ - widely used EnergyPlus weather source; underlying data NOAA; design values ASHRAE
geographic_relevance: High - Central Park, ~4 km from site
limitations: Typical, not extreme; Central Park not Chelsea microclimate. Chosen over DOE TMY3 (1973-2005 record, no design conditions) for recency

name: EIA-861M monthly electricity sales/revenue + EIA natural gas prices (New York)
geographic_relevance: Medium - New York State averages (Con Ed territory is higher)
temporal_coverage: Electricity 2010-01 to 2026-07 (last 19 months preliminary); gas 1989-01 to 2026-07
limitations: State average not Con Ed tariff; no demand charges; no steam price

name: NYISO hourly integrated real-time load (palIntegrated) - Zone J N.Y.C.
geographic_relevance: High - Zone J is New York City
temporal_coverage: Calendar 2025 (8759 h; one DST hour merged)
limitations: Load only (no marginal emissions); 2025 summer peak 10825 MW vs winter 7552 MW

name: Technology Data for Electricity and District Heating - data sheet (Aug 2026)
geographic_relevance: Medium - Danish market costs; technology physics transferable
granularity: Per technology size class (central / lower / upper)
completeness: Heat-pump rows complete; gas DH boiler has no lower/upper bounds
limitations: EUR 2020 and Danish labour/permits; excess-heat HP datasheet assumes 25->15 C source and 35->70 C DH; heat storage and pipes are in separate DEA catalogues (not downloaded)

name: Updated Buildings Sector Appliance and Equipment Costs and Efficiencies (Mar 2023)
status: transcribed (13 values; all auto-verified against PDF text)
limitations: Building-scale units (48-800 kBtu/h, 400 ton chiller) - not district-scale heat-recovery chillers

name: NYC Local Law 97 emission coefficients and penalty
publisher: NYC Council / Dept of Buildings (Admin. Code 28-320)
status: transcribed (5 coefficients verified in law text)
completeness: 5/5 coefficients found verbatim in the law PDF
limitations: 2030+ grid coefficient set by later rule (not included); NYCHA uses a different compliance pathway (Article 321)
replaces_in_html: ll97 (law text replaces the Accelerator brief); replaces egrid

name: Organizer source pack - engineering parameters and reference cases
publisher: Hackathon organizers (OCP, CBS, DEA ch.40, IDEA, HDR, DATA HEAT, DGA, CenTrio, FPCJ, site pack)
completeness: 35 parameters + 11 cases; every row carries a source quote
limitations: Not observations; use as ranges and benchmarks; team assumptions A01-A05 must be shown as sliders
replaces_in_html: org_packet, org_regen, org_site, org_de_refs, ocp_101, dataheat, sp111

name: Con Edison steam tariff (PSC No. 4 - Steam)
limitations: Needed to price Fulton's 29.4 GWh/yr steam baseline

name: PSC Case 22-M-0429 Con Ed thermal-network pilot filings
limitations: Only source of real Manhattan network cost and Phase 0 scope

name: Con Edison SC-8 / SC-9 electricity tariffs
limitations: EIA NY average used meanwhile

limitations: Use as default with sensitivity
